text: Four hubs can still present a mode-alternative clarify: cli-external (7 modes), sk-doc (15), sk-design (4), sk-code (5). system-deep-loop and sk-code's policy card list checklist sentences; cli-classifier has one mode so its branch is unreachable; mcp-tooling never clarifies.

Per-hub accuracy on the fixture differs sharply: sk-doc 9/13, mcp-tooling 9/12, sk-code 4/7, cli-external 4/11, sk-design 2/11 (0 of 9 none rows). Expansion must be per hub; sk-design is contraindicated on this corpus.

The advisor measured the same judgment twice and killed it: 002 pick-first (Jev W=11 L=27, p_loss=0.0069; Deem W=8 L=30); 019 whole-cluster (Jev W=13 L=25 p=0.9832, MRR 0.7260 vs 0.7811). The keep does not carry across surfaces.
Sibling keep with a strong comparator: 022 A=39 vs B=30 W=10 L=1 p=0.0059 (comparator 30/40) against 020's 15/54. The judgment pays where the incumbent is real.
The reusable asset is the measurement kit (census, digests, exact BigInt tail, modal pick, scorer, verdict); 002/019/021 rebuilt their own.
Real corpora rarely reach the surface: 2 mode-alternative clarify rows over 361 committed prompts; 021's tie-break arms never ran (2 tied rows of 58, no headroom). Base rate unmeasured.
Checklist clarifies need a different option producer; the census already separates clarify_mode from clarify_checklist and describeModes only understands mode keys.
